value.rationale: Exact coverage of ordinal ranking space is a motivated new metric on structured preferences. The complete-bipartite family is the simplest cyclic extension of the studied star, allowing a strict graph-balance extremal theorem and three distinct limiting distance laws. The quantitative shift of outer-diversity deficit from order 1/m to 1/m^2 is mathematically structural rather than a routine small case or arbitrary precision improvement.
